text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Hanshin 
Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The fans were hoping to see an entry in 
the Tenno Sho (Spring). They wanted to 
witness a clash with Rice Shower, the 
"Jet-Black Assassin"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is a powerhouse who thwarted 
the great achievements of Mejiro McQueen 
and Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian decided without hesitation to 
run in the Tenno Sho (Spring).
